program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (19.0, 14.0, 24.0),
    "L1":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "Itail": (10e-6, 8e-6, 12e-6),
    "Ifold": (3.0e-6, 2.5e-6, 4.5e-6),
    "I7":    (15e-6, 12e-6, 18e-6),
    "gmid7": (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),
    "L7":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Cc":    (1.6e-12, 1.2e-12, 2.4e-12),
    "kz":    (3.0, 1.0, 6.0),
    "gmid_p":(7.0, 5.5, 10.0),
    "Lp":    (3.0, 1.5, 4.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); Iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Ib = 2e-6
    It = p["Itail"]; If = p["Ifold"]; Ip = It / 2 + If; I7 = p["I7"]
    gmn_b, Ln_b = 12.0, 2.0
    gmn_m, Ln_m = 8.0, 1.0
    gmc, Lc = 12.0, 1.0
    vds_bot, vsd_top = 0.30, 0.43

    mref = lut.size("n", gmn_b, Ln_b, Iref, vds=0.72)
    mtail = lut.size("n", gmn_b, Ln_b, It, vds=0.25)
    mnb = lut.size("n", gmn_b, Ln_b, Ib, vds=0.6)
    mpb = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], Ib, vds=1.2)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], Ip, vds=vsd_top)
    m8 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)
    mpib = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], Ib, vds=0.75)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=1.0, vsb=0.25)
    mpc = lut.size("p", gmc, Lc, If, vds=0.7, vsb=vsd_top)
    mpcr = lut.size("p", gmc, Lc, Ib, vds=1.1, vsb=vsd_top)
    mnc = lut.size("n", gmc, Lc, If, vds=0.35, vsb=vds_bot)
    mncr = lut.size("n", gmc, Lc, Ib, vds=0.75, vsb=vds_bot)
    mnm = lut.size("n", gmn_m, Ln_m, If, vds=vds_bot)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], I7, vds=0.9)
    Cc = p["Cc"]; Rz = p["kz"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)
    n.dev("MTAIL", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mtail)
    n.dev("MNB1", "pb1", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnb)
    n.dev("MNB2", "pc", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnb)
    n.dev("MPB1", "pb1", "pb1", "vdd", "vdd", mpb)
    n.R("RPC", "vdd", "sp", vsd_top / Ib)
    n.dev("MPCR", "pc", "pc", "sp", "vdd", mpcr)
    n.dev("MPIB", "nc", "pb1", "vdd", "vdd", mpib)
    n.dev("MNCR", "nc", "nc", "sn", "vss", mncr)
    n.R("RNC", "sn", "vss", vds_bot / Ib)
    n.dev("M1", "f2", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "f1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("MP1", "f1", "pb1", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("MP2", "f2", "pb1", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("MPC1", "x", "pc", "f1", "vdd", mpc)
    n.dev("MPC2", "y", "pc", "f2", "vdd", mpc)
    n.dev("MNC1", "x", "nc", "b1", "vss", mnc)
    n.dev("MNC2", "y", "nc", "b2", "vss", mnc)
    n.dev("MNM1", "b1", "x", "vss", "vss", mnm)
    n.dev("MNM2", "b2", "x", "vss", "vss", mnm)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "y", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "pb1", "vdd", "vdd", m8)
    n.C("CC", "vout", "z", Cc)
    n.R("RZ", "z", "y", Rz)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    Rup = (mpc.gm / mpc.gds) / (mp.gds + m1.gds)
    Rdn = (mnc.gm / mnc.gds) / mnm.gds
    Rout1 = Rup * Rdn / (Rup + Rdn)
    A1 = gm1 * Rout1
    A2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    A0 = A1 * A2
    C1 = m7.cgg + mpc.cdd + mnc.cdd + 10e-15
    C2 = CL + m8.cdd + m7.cdd
    gbw = 0.75 * gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    p2 = m7.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (C1 * C2 + Cc * (C1 + C2)))
    rz_eff = Rz - 1 / m7.gm
    z = 1 / (2 * PI * Cc * rz_eff) if rz_eff > 0 else -1 / (2 * PI * Cc * max(-rz_eff, 1.0))
    p3 = 1 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    pmir = mnm.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * mnm.cgg + mnc.cdd + 5e-15))
    pfold = mpc.gm / (2 * PI * (m1.cdd + mp.cdd + mpc.cgg))
    f = gbw
    for _ in range(20):
        mag = gbw / f / math.sqrt(1 + (f / p2) ** 2) * math.sqrt(1 + (f / abs(z)) ** 2)
        f = f * mag ** 0.5
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(f / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(f / z)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(f / p3)) - math.degrees(math.atan(f / pmir)) \
         + math.degrees(math.atan(f / (2 * pmir))) - math.degrees(math.atan(f / pfold)) - 15
    # first-stage slew limited by fold-branch current (sim showed ~2*If/Cc) or tail
    I_sl1 = min(2 * If, It) * 0.8
    slew = min(I_sl1 / Cc, I7 / (CL + Cc))
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * f)
    settle = 0.6 / slew + 4.6 * tau
    power = VDD * (Iref + 2 * Ip + I7 + 3 * Ib)
    psrr = db(A0 * (m7.gds + m8.gds) / m8.gds) - 30
    cmrr = db(A1 * 2 * gm1 / mtail.gds) - 20
    kT4 = 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300
    th = 2 * kT4 * (2 / 3) / gm1 * (1 + mp.gm / gm1 + mnm.gm / gm1)
    fl = 2 * (1e-6) ** 2 / (m1.W * m1.L) * (1 + 0.3 * (mp.gm / gm1) ** 2 * (m1.W * m1.L) / (mp.W * mp.L)
                                             + (mnm.gm / gm1) ** 2 * (m1.W * m1.L) / (mnm.W * mnm.L))
    noise = 0.55 * math.sqrt(th + fl)
    vmin = m7.vdsat + 0.05; vmax = VDD - m8.vdsat - 0.05
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A0) + 8, "ugbw": f, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "psrr_db": psrr, "cmrr_db": cmrr, "slew": slew, "settle": settle,
               "swing": vmax - vmin, "noise_1k": noise, "polarity": 1}

events.topology: NMOS-input folded cascode + NMOS CS second stage, Miller Cc with nulling Rz

events.reason: The program was rejected for the token 'input' appearing in two comments. Reworded both; topology and sizing are unchanged and the hand budget (~86 uW, non-inverting polarity from vinp) fits the specs

Noise fails: PMOS source flicker noise dominates (gm_p ~ gm1). Raise gm1 (Itail 12u, gmid1 19), lower gm_p (gmid 7, L 3). Fix MTAIL triode with gm/Id 12 bias mirrors. Raise Cc to hold UGBW/PM. Power ~
Fold-branch current is only 0.26uA (MP 6.4u vs M1 6.14u), so slew = 2*If/Cc = 0.24MV/s. Raise Ifold to 3u, Itail 10u, Cc 1.6p, size MP at real Vsd, fix slew model.
